rounds.diagnosis: Stage 'carry the teapot upright over the mug': the subgoal standoff is far too small. trans[1] 'above mug.opening_center, clearance contact, slack snug' puts teapot.spout_tip only 0-2 cm above the mug opening, while the pot's body extends 21 cm horizontally and its handle sits 2.7 cm below the spout tip, so every pose in the region drives the teapot into the mug and the table ('no collision-free pose found in the region'). Re-emit the stage with a standoff clearance large enough that the whole pot body and handle hover clear of the mug rim (a 'large' clearance above mug.opening_center), keeping the upright rotation rows on path and subgoal as they are. Stage 'tilt the teapot to pour into the mug': (a) its path z band is unreachable from the entry pose - once the previous stage ends at a proper pouring height the bands must agree, or leave z free on the path / split off a lift; (b) path.rot[0] holds teapot.front_axis antiparallel to mug.up_axis with tol tight from entry to subgoal, which forbids the very tilt the stage performs, since the entry pose is upright - the pour rotation must be constrained only at the subgoal, with the path rotation left free (or only limited enough to keep the spout pointing toward the mug).
